All numbers below are from a local run of the pinned `markdownlint-cli2@0.23.3` with `.trunk/configs/.markdownlint.yaml` over `docs/**` + `assets/docs/**` (1048 findings total). ## Root causes | Rule | docs/ | assets/ | Cause | |---|---|---|---| | MD025 | 309 | 250 | Every page uses one H1 *per section* (`# Button`, `# Installation`, `# Usage`, `# Anatomy`, `# Examples`, `# API Reference`). Also, MD025's default `front_matter_title` makes the frontmatter `title:` count as the first H1 — so even the page-title H1 is flagged (`docs/components/button.md:7`). | | MD060 | 212 | 212 | Table pipes not aligned with the padded header row — formatting-only; tables are copied verbatim into the assets, hence the identical counts. | | MD001 | 0 | 34 | Generator-caused: `scripts/generate_markdown.py:151-152` emits `### CLI` / `### Manual Installation` directly under the source `# Installation` H1 (level skip 1→3 exists only in generated files). | | MD024 | 5 | 5 | Intentional cross-section duplicates: `## field.set`/`field.group`/`field.root` under both `# Composition` and `# API Reference` (`docs/components/field.md`), `## Button` under `# API Reference`, `## Doughnut Chart` under `# Examples`. | | MD036 | 3 | 3 | Bold pseudo-headings above props tables: `**autocomplete**` (`docs/components/autocomplete.md:68`), `**chart_tooltip()**` / `**chart_tooltip_content()**` (`docs/components/chart.md:214,226`). | | MD041 | 4 | — | `README.md` (blockquote before `# buridan/ui`), `CHANGELOG.md` (starts `## Unreleased`), `LICENSE.md` (plain "MIT License"), `CLAUDE.md` (HTML comment first). | | MD056/MD058/MD059/MD040 | — | — | Already fixed on #128's branch (unmerged): field.md:137/168 unescaped pipes, frame.md:91 blank line, changelog.md:54 `[here]`, skills.md:38 fence language. Nothing left here once #128 lands. | ## Triage - **Not a duplicate.** #129 is the *rule-configuration* umbrella (ruff ANN/INP001, pyrefly, checkov) — it doesn't cover MD025/MD060. Its only overlap is the four root-file MD041s, which this issue explicitly claims; suggest keeping that bucket here and striking it from #129's scope to avoid double work (`.entire/graph-agent.md` stays in #129). - **Depends on #128** (still open, touches the same docs files + regenerated assets) — rebase on it before starting. - #123 §4 is the fix-pass umbrella this triage belongs to. ## Implementation plan **1. Rule config** (`.trunk/configs/.markdownlint.yaml` — targeted scoping, nothing disabled wholesale, so the "no loosening to pass" rule is respected): ```yaml MD025: front_matter_title: "" # pages legitimately carry both a metadata title (nav via app/utils/routes.py, meta via app/export.py) and one visible H1 MD024: siblings_only: true # duplicates are intentional cross-section API docs; rule still catches true same-parent duplicates MD060: false # pure pipe-alignment whitespace; the config's own header is "all formatting rules disabled" and MD060 post-dates it ``` Do **not** disable the `tables` tag — that would also kill MD056/MD058, which catch real errors. (Zero-config alternative for MD060: a one-off realignment pass over the 25 table-bearing docs files; render-neutral either way.) **2. Content change in `docs/**`** (the source of truth — `assets/docs/**` is regenerated, never hand-edited): - Demote to one H1 per page: keep the first `# `, shift every other ATX heading +1 level (`#`→`##`, `##`→`###`) across all 59 files. Scriptable one-pass sweep that tracks code fences so `#` comment lines inside fenced blocks are untouched. This also clears all 34 asset MD001s with **no generator change** — `### CLI`/`### Manual Installation` then nest correctly under `## Installation`. - MD036: turn the three bold pseudo-headings into real headings (`**autocomplete**` → `### autocomplete`, etc.). - MD041 root files: move README's blockquote below `# buridan/ui`; add `# Changelog` atop CHANGELOG.md; `# MIT License` heading in LICENSE.md; add an H1 atop CLAUDE.md. **3. Runtime follow-ups the demotion requires** (otherwise the site regresses): - `app/www/style.py` — `markdown_component_map` has only `h1`/`h2`, and `render_heading` renders any non-1 level as `<h2>`; add `h3` (and `h4` if chart.md's Props sub-blocks need it) with a new `HEADING_3_CLASS` (keep `scroll-mt-14` — anchor ids and scrollspy offsets come from there). Without this, demoted subsections render unstyled with no anchor id and TOC links break. - `app/www/generator.py:64` — widen the TOC regex `^(#{1,2})` → `^(#{1,3})` so demoted subsections stay in the TOC (`app/templates/toc.py:73` already indents any level > 1). - Sections visually drop text-2xl → text-xl; optionally re-tune the `HEADING_*` classes if the visual hierarchy should be preserved exactly. **4. Regenerate + verify:** - `uv run python scripts/generate_markdown.py`, commit `assets/docs/**` (CI gates `git diff --exit-code assets/docs`). Note the assets are **user-facing**: "View Markdown" / "Copy Page" in `app/templates/toc.py` fetch `/{url}.md`, which resolves into `assets/docs/**` — so they must stay lint-clean, not be trunk-ignored. The pre-existing `> **Error in anatomy …**` markers regenerate identically (known `app.www.anatomy` import mismatch) — not new breakage. - Re-lint with the pinned tool (or `trunk check --filter markdownlint-cli2 --all --show-existing`, which also proves the repo-local config override wins, per #123 §3) → expect 0. - `uv run pytest tests/ -q` (regeneration-gate tests + `tests/test_toc_scrollspy.py`; its 1 skip is the missing Node harness, expected). **Validated end-to-end:** demoted `docs/components/button.md` (first H1 kept, all other headings +1) + the three config overrides above → 0 findings with the pinned linter. MD025/MD024/MD056/MD058 all remain active rules afterwards — they'll enforce the new one-H1-per-page structure. <details> <summary>Task list (6/6 completed)</summary> - [x] Check for duplicate issues (#129, #123, #128 inspected) - [x] Reproduce all markdownlint findings with pinned markdownlint-cli2@0.23.3 - [x] Root-cause each rule bucket (MD025/MD060/MD001/MD024/MD036/MD041) - [x] Trace runtime impact of heading demotion (style.py, generator.py, toc.py, assets serving) - [x] Validate the proposed fix combo end-to-end on button.md - [x] Post implementation plan on issue #131 </details> <!-- PULLFROG_DIVIDER_DO_NOT_REMOVE_PLZ --> <sup><a href="https://pullfrog.com"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://pullfrog.com/logos/frog-white-full-18px.png"><img src="https://pullfrog.com/logos/frog-green-full-18px.png" width="9px" height="9px" style="vertical-align: middle; " alt="Pullfrog"></picture></a>  ｜ [Implement a fix ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/131?action=build) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/actions/runs/38965799341/job/117191839094) ｜ via [Pullfrog](https://pullfrog.com) ｜ Using `glm-5p3` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)</sup> --

18:Reflex wraps [Recharts](https://recharts.github.io/) under the hood. This means you build your own charts using Recharts components and only bring in your theme tokens and custom components like `chart_tooltip` when and where you need it.
37:buridan/ui provides a custom `chart_tooltip` that can be used to match the overall theme tokens generated. 
39:--INSTALL(chart_tooltip)--
101:To add a tooltip, we'll use the custom `chart_tooltip` and `chart_tooltip_content` components from chart.
103:>**Note**: A small comment regarding the custom tooltip. Because of the way Recharts is composed and the way it's wrapped in Reflex, the custom tooltip, as of now, works for Area, Bar, Line, and Pie charts. # Changelog

Latest updates and announcements.

## July 2026 - API Consolidation & High Fidelity

Following the introduction of our theming engine, the focus shifted entirely toward refining and consolidating the underlying component APIs. The core mission of this release was to bring the library's structural orchestration and code patterns into complete alignment with the high-fidelity standards established by `shadcn/ui`.

This update moves away from standalone, fluid function parameters in favor of a unified namespace pattern. Components are now split cleanly into dedicated structural elements, such as `.root()` and `.item()`. This pattern allows users to build composite layouts with declarative precision, ensuring clean, intuitive component hierarchies across any application.

Alongside structural improvements, the underlying style aggregation engine was rebuilt to natively support strict Tailwind merge inheritance `(cn)`. Custom, per-instance layout parameters (such as explicit dimension overrides) are now safely appended at the end of the style cascade. This eliminates utility specificity conflicts and gives developers reliable, uncompromised control over layout sizes and layouts.


## June 2026 - buridan/create

The key feature introduced is the `buridan/create` feature. Based on the popular shadcn/ui, this feature allows users to generate their own CSS tokens and apply it to their Reflex projects. Local development or via [Reflex Build](https://build.reflex.dev/), both are covered. 

No more purple/green dashboards and components with inconsistent spacing and obscure alignments, with /create users have full control of their theme system that provides clean, minimal, and consistent styling that can be applied to any Reflex app. 

[buridan/create](/create) lets users generate unique presets that can be saved and shared. You can customize everything from the ground up and that includes fonts, color schemes, and more.

> Want to build your theme visually? Use [buridan/create](/create) to preview colors, radius, and fonts, then generate a preset for your project.
